protocol.preprocessing: fit separately within every training subset; fixed documented categorical vocabulary
protocol.noise: Gaussian SD = level × outer-training numeric SD; bounded by feature schema; categorical values unchanged
protocol.missing: additional MCAR cell masking; existing missing values retained; same draws across levels
protocol.standard_deviation: Descriptive sample SD across fold or fold/perturbation evaluations; not a confidence interval
protocol.selection: Fixed research configuration, no hyperparameter search and no deployment/model selection
protocol.artifact_relation: New fold-specific estimators; does not evaluate or replace the previously deployed full UCI artifact

limitations: Research configurations are distinct from the original nested-CV benchmark and frozen production models.
Repeated use of these CV results for model selection requires a new independent evaluation.
MCAR masking and bounded Gaussian noise are controlled perturbations, not a claim about real missingness mechanisms.
Fold samples overlap in training. Descriptive SD does not quantify uncertainty of the full learning procedure.
No clinical validation or future-event prediction is established.
